Diego — thanks for the clear summary. A few quick notes from our security and procurement teams: 

- Audit window: we prefer Q2 2027 (May) for re-attestation to line up with our internal calendar.
- Evidence list (minimum): SOC 2 report (most recent), control narratives, system architecture diagram, user access reviews (samples), change-management logs (90 days + recent 12 months summary), retention policy, and a 7-day rolling log sample for ingestion and export verification.
- For retention increases we need confirmation of encryption-at-rest and key management (KMS details) and an SLA addendum that covers retention durability.
- Regarding throughput: procurement will require a pricing delta for Dedicated vs. hosted with burst profile defined (we use a 95th percentile for billing alignment).

Can you provide the log sample as a gzipped export and a stub DocuSign amendment link for term + retention + capacity terms? Also attach any mapping between your storage classes and our retention banding.

I’ve cc’d contracts so they can pick up the legal amendment once we have the MAP.

Thanks,
